ruleset.name: sail-main-pending
ruleset.description: The families not yet burned down, as AGENTS.md "Quality gate" lists them with their counts: method-level complexity (CognitiveComplexity, CyclomaticComplexity, NPathComplexity, AvoidDeeplyNestedIfStmts, NcssCount, ExcessiveParameterList), whose CyclomaticComplexity and NcssCount also hold the class-level sums. A family's rules move to pmd-main.xml, unchanged, in the pull request that makes it clean in every module.

rule.message: The {0} ''{1}'' has a{2} cyclomatic complexity of {3} (limit: 15 per method, 80 per class)
if statements are nested 3 or more deep (limit: a depth of 2)
The {0} ''{1}'' has a NCSS line count of {2} (limit: 60 per method, 600 per class)
